items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Right. I haven’t seen the stuff but I know it.

ctx.x: Fingerings, like high G — that’s not going to work right now [scale] sorry, you may want to edit this part. [more horn] Yeah, all the regular fingerings usually is what I do. And then I’ll do kind of I guess random stuff where it’s kind of [scats] like in between notes and stuff. But not as much as like the overtone thing like you were talking about, it’s mostly fingerings.
Right, that was more of a classical thing to learn, of the Sigurd Rascher.
Right. I haven’t seen the stuff but I know it.
